readme:
# EURAXESS Scraper - Research, PhD and Postdoc Jobs Across Europe

Pull job offers from [EURAXESS](https://euraxess.ec.europa.eu), the European Commission's researcher job portal (roughly 6,400 live job offers across 60+ countries, from universities, research institutes, hospitals and companies). Every row returns the employer, location with coordinates, application deadline, research fields, researcher career stage, contract type, hours, start date, reference number, contact e-mail and phone, the apply URL and the full description as text, HTML and Markdown. No login and no API key.

## What you get

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `id`, `job_url`, `apply_url` | EURAXESS job number, the EURAXESS page, and where to apply (the employer or job board link when the job page has one) |
| `title`, `company_name` | Offer title and the hiring organisation |
| `publisher_name`, `publisher_profile_url`, `publisher_logo_url` | The EURAXESS organisation profile that posted the offer. This can be a job board such as Academic Positions rather than the employer |
| `location`, `city`, `region`, `country`, `postal_code`, `street_address`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `work_locations` | First work location, plus every work location as a list |
| `posted_at`, `posted_at_datetime`, `posted_at_text` | Posting day as ISO 8601 UTC (the site publishes the day only, so the time is 00:00:00Z) |
| `expires_at`, `application_deadline`, `application_deadline_text` | Application deadline as ISO 8601 UTC, and as printed on the site |
| `employment_type`, `contract_type`, `contract_type_details`, `working_hours`, `hours_per_week`, `start_date` | Full-time or Part-time, contract type, hours per week, offer start date |
| `research_fields`, `category`, `researcher_profiles`, `position_level`, `positions` | Research fields (Parent » Child), career stage R1 to R4, PhD or postdoc position type |
| `education_required`, `experience_required`, `languages`, `requirements`, `benefits_text` | Requirements as published |
| `funding_programme`, `is_research_infrastructure_position`, `reference_number` | EU funding answer, research infrastructure flag, employer reference |
| `contact_email`, `contact_emails`, `contact_phone`, `contact_phones`, `contact_fax`, `contact_website`, `contact_address`, `company_website` | Contact block of the job page |
| `description_full`, `description_snippet`, `description_html`, `description_md` | Offer description in four formats |
| `selection_process`, `eligibility_criteria`, `additional_comments`, `additional_sections`, `attachments`, `additional_info_url` | Extra text blocks and attached files when the employer filled them in |
| `search_query`, `source`, `detail_fetched`, `scraped_at` | Which keyword found the row, source tag, whether the job page was opened, scrape time |

Not available on EURAXESS, so not in the output: salary, a named contact person, and remote/hybrid status. Salary or benefits sometimes appear inside the description text or in `benefits_text`.

## Quick start

`{}` works: with no input the actor returns the 50 newest job offers across all countries.

```json
{
  "countries": ["Switzerland"],
  "searchQueries": ["laboratory technician", "chemistry"],
  "researcherProfiles": ["R1", "R2"],
  "sortBy": "newest",
  "postedWithinDays": 14,
  "includeJobDetails": true,
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 50,
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

Daily "what is new" run for one country: `{"countries": ["Germany"], "sortBy": "newest", "postedWithinDays": 1, "maxResults": 200}`.

## Input

| Input | Server-side or client-side | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `searchQueries` | Server-side | Keyword search, one search per keyword. Rows are tagged in `search_query` and de-duplicated across keywords. Empty list lists everything that matches the other filters |
| `countries` | Server-side | Several countries are OR-combined. Empty means all countries |
| `location` | Server-side for a country name, otherwise client-side | A country name acts like `countries`. Any other text (a city such as `Zurich`) is matched against the location text of each search result |
| `researcherProfiles` | Server-side | `R1` first stage (PhD level), `R2` recognised (postdoc), `R3` established, `R4` leading, `other` (technicians and administration) |
| `positionTypes` | Server-side | `phd`, `postdoc`, `master`, `bachelor`, `undergraduate`, `research_support`, `other` |
| `organisationTypes` | Server-side | Higher education, public research institution, research laboratory, SME and start-up, large enterprise, and more |
| `euFunding` | Server-side | Horizon Europe (ERC, MSCA, COFUND, EIC), Horizon 2020, Erasmus+, Interreg, LIFE, or `not_eu_funded` |
| `researchFields` | Server-side | Names as on EURAXESS (for example `Chemistry`, `Computer science`) or numeric ids. A top-level field also matches its sub-fields |
| `sortBy` | Server-side | `newest` (posting date, newest first), `relevance` (the site's default order), `deadline` (soonest deadline first) |
| `postedWithinDays`, `maxAgeHours` | Client-side cutoff | EURAXESS has no date filter. With `sortBy: newest` the crawl stops at the first older job, so recent-only runs read only a page or two. With other sorts every page is read and older jobs are dropped |
| `titleFilter` | Client-side | Comma-separated terms, case-insensitive match on the title. Applied before job pages are opened, so jobs dropped by the filter are not charged |
| `maxResults`, `maxResultsPerQuery` | Actor | Total cap (default 50) and per-keyword cap (default: same as `maxResults`) |
| `includeJobDetails` | Actor | On (default): opens each job page. Off: search-result fields only (title, publisher, location text, deadline, research fields, profile, short teaser) |
| `searchUrls`, `directUrls`, `startUrls` | n/a | Paste EURAXESS search URLs (filters and sort in the URL are honoured), job URLs, or a mix |
| `maxConcurrency` | Actor | Parallel job-page fetches, 1 to 4 (default 2) |

Notes on how EURAXESS behaves:

- Only job offers are returned (the site also lists funding and hosting offers, which are excluded).
- The posting date has day precision only. `maxAgeHours` and `postedWithinDays` keep a job when any part of its posting day is inside the window.
- `sortBy: relevance` is the site's own default order, which is close to newest-first but not strictly by date.
- Some job pages carry no description (the employer only linked out). Those rows still have title, employer, deadline and apply URL.
- Speed: about 30 jobs per minute with job pages on (a 200-job run takes roughly 6 minutes, 100 jobs about 2 to 3 minutes). Search-only runs (`includeJobDetails: false`) read 10 jobs per request and are faster. EURAXESS limits how fast one visitor may read it, so very large runs (thousands of jobs) take proportionally longer; the actor handles this on its own and needs no setup.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

Configure the MCP server with EURAXESS Scraper preconfigured at `mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/euraxess-scraper`.

```json
{
    "mcpServers": {
        "apify": {
            "command": "npx",
            "args": [
                "mcp-remote",
                "https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=santamaria-automations/euraxess-scraper",
                "--header",
                "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_TOKEN>"
            ]
        }
    }
}
```

For per-tool schemas and copy-paste snippets for MCP clients, see the [MCP tab](https://console.apify.com/actors/j31v9WsSBzUWZlmZA/info/api/mcp?build=latest).

See the [auto-generated API tab](https://console.apify.com/actors/j31v9WsSBzUWZlmZA/info/api) for language-specific examples (cURL, JS, Python, .NET, Ruby, PHP).

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `euraxess-scraper` to find PhD and postdoc positions in chemistry in Switzerland posted in the last 14 days. Return employer, deadline, contact e-mail and apply URL as a table."

## Why this actor

- Real server-side filtering for country, keyword, career stage, position type, organisation type, EU funding and research field, so you only pay for rows you asked for.
- Newest-first with stop-early: daily runs with `postedWithinDays` read only the first page or two.
- Employer, contact e-mail, phone, reference number, work-location coordinates, requirements and benefits as separate fields, not buried in a description blob.
- Detail pages that fail to load are billed as search-level rows, not as full detail rows.

## Output example

```json
{
  "id": "471116",
  "title": "Associate professor / Assistant professor pecialised in biochemistry",
  "job_url": "https://euraxess.ec.europa.eu/jobs/471116",
  "company_name": "University of Ostrava",
  "company_website": "http://www.osu.cz",
  "location": "Ostrava, Czech Republic",
  "city": "Ostrava",
  "country": "Czech Republic",
  "posted_at_datetime": "2026-10-07T00:00:00Z",
  "application_deadline": "2026-11-07T22:59:59Z",
  "employment_type": "Part-time",
  "contract_type": "Temporary",
  "hours_per_week": 8,
  "start_date": "2026-11-01",
  "research_fields": ["Medical sciences"],

  "contact_emails": ["personalnilf@osu.cz"],

}
```

## Pricing

Pay per event, no subscription:

| Event | Price | When |
|---|---|---|
| Run start | $0.001 | Once per run |
| Job Detail Result | $0.005 | Each job row with the full job page (default) |
| Job Search Result | $0.003 | Each job row from search results only (`includeJobDetails: false`) |

A detail page that fails to load is billed as a search result, not as a detail result. Duplicates across keywords are removed before billing. 100 jobs with details cost about $0.50 plus the start fee.

## Common use cases

- Weekly feed of new PhD and postdoc openings for a university research office or recruiter.
- Lab technician and research support job alerts for one country (`researcherProfiles: ["other"]`).
- Funding-aware search: MSCA, ERC and COFUND positions only.
- Feed `company_website` and contact e-mails into an outreach or CRM workflow.

- [Website Contact Extractor](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/website-contact-extractor): feed it `company_website` to extract contact names, phones and socials.

## Support

- **Questions or issues?** Email contact@nanoscrape.com, we typically reply within 6 hours. You can also open a ticket in the [Issues tab](https://console.apify.com/actors/j31v9WsSBzUWZlmZA/info/issues) on the actor page.
- **Feature request for this actor?** Open a ticket in the [Issues tab](https://console.apify.com/actors/j31v9WsSBzUWZlmZA/info/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com with the field you need and, if possible, a URL that shows the data live.
- **Need a scraper for a job board we don't cover yet?** Email contact@nanoscrape.com with the target site and your rough usage volume.
